testcase.name: Scenario: Transfer a selected category containing commands and a separator: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1592:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Transfer a selected category containing commands and a separator ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows an empty Part Tools target ✔ And the available command category is Exit 2D Sketch Tab ✔ And the source list shows Separator, Cancel Sketch, and Finish Sketch in that order ✔ When the user clicks Cancel Sketch in the source list ✔ And the user presses Ctrl+A while the source list has focus ✔ Then all three source entries are highlighted ✔ When the user clicks the transfer-to-target button ✔ Then the target contains Cancel Sketch, Separator, and Finish Sketch in that order ✔ And the source list still contains Separator ✔ And the two commands have Large and Text unchecked ✔ And Part Tools is marked as having pending changes ✔ When the user cancels ribbon customization ✔ Then the customization dialog closes
